_about: gate-llm panel configuration. Copy next to the panel (e.g. /etc/gate-llm/panel.json) and adapt. The panel is read-only: it polls each gatekeeper's status endpoint (reading it never wakes a backend) and nvidia-smi, and accumulates its own counters in a state file from the day it is installed -- history is never back-filled. Keys starting with _ are comments and are ignored.
_gpu_hour_price_usd: Reference price of one GPU-hour, used ONLY for the avoided-cost estimate, which is always printed together with this assumption. null = no cost figure is shown.
_services: One entry per gatekeeper you want on the page. status_url is that gatekeeper's status endpoint (/__gate-llm/status on its listen port). vram_mib is the service's VRAM footprint while awake, measured on your machine (the panel uses it only for the GPU-hours-returned estimate; omit it and the service is excluded from that estimate).
_state_file: null = panel-state.json next to this config file.
